description: Multi-View Category Chart turns a single category-and-series dataset into a clean grid of small-multiple charts — one per category (region, store, product line, or business unit) — each broken down by your chosen series. Viewers switch every chart between Pie, Donut, and Bar views with one toggle, backed by a shared interactive legend that cross-highlights all charts at once, flexible value and percentage labels, full number formatting, and one-click PNG export. It's built for analysts, report designers, and decision-makers who need to compare the same breakdown across many groups at a glance. Standard pie and bar visuals show only one breakdown at a time, forcing cluttered canvases or constant clicking — this visual renders them all together in a responsive, consistent layout for faster, clearer comparison.
